attributes.field_kotobagaki: 長元八年、宇治前太政大臣の家に歌合しけるに、かちかたのをのことも、すみよしにまうてて歌よみ侍けるによめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 長元八年、宇治前太政大臣の家に歌合しけるに、かちかたのをのことも、すみよしにまうてて歌よみ侍けるによめる
attributes.field_text: 住吉の / なみにひたれる / 松よりも / 神のしるしそ / あらはれにける
attributes.field_text_romaji: Sumiyoshi no / nami ni hitareru / matsu yori mo / kami no shirushi zo / arawarenikeru
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Sumiyoshi no / nami ni hitareru / matsu yori mo / kami no shirushi zo / arawarenikeru

attributes.title: 5bfc17dfa7372ae5b22441d5
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 返し
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 返し
attributes.field_text: ととこほる / 事はなけれと / 住吉の / まつ心にや / ひさしかるらん
attributes.field_text_romaji: todokōru / koto wa nakeredo / Sumiyoshi no / matsu kokoro ni ya / hisashikaruran
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: todokōru / koto wa nakeredo / Sumiyoshi no / matsu kokoro ni ya / hisashikaruran

attributes.title: 5bfc17dfa7372ae5b22441d6
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 住吉の / ほそ江にさせる / みをつくし / 深きにまけぬ / 人はあらしな
attributes.field_text_romaji: Sumiyoshi no / hosoe ni saseru / mi o tsukushi / fukaki ni makenu / hito wa araji na
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Sumiyoshi no / hosoe ni saseru / mi o tsukushi / fukaki ni makenu / hito wa araji na

attributes.title: 5bfc17dfa7372ae5b22441d7
attributes.field_text: 住吉の松の風ひさしくつたはり、玉津島のなみながくしづかにして
attributes.field_text_romaji: Sumiyoshi no matsu no kaze hisashiku tsutawari Tamatsushima no nami nagaku shizuka ni shite
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Sumiyoshi no matsu no kaze hisashiku tsutawari Tamatsushima no nami nagaku shizuka ni shite

attributes.title: 5bfc17dfa7372ae5b22441d8
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 津守国基身まかりて後、住吉にもすます成にけるを、有基にくしてあからさまにくたりて侍けるに、人のこころもかはりて見え侍けれは、松のもとをけつりてかきつけ侍ける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 津守国基身まかりて後、住吉にもすます成にけるを、有基にくしてあからさまにくたりて侍けるに、人のこころもかはりて見え侍けれは、松のもとをけつりてかきつけ侍ける
attributes.field_text: 人こころ / あらすなれとも / 住吉の / 松のけしきは / かはらさりけり
attributes.field_text_romaji: hito kokoro / arazu naredomo / Sumiyoshi no / matsu no keshiki  wa / kawarazarikeri
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: hito kokoro / arazu naredomo / Sumiyoshi no / matsu no keshiki  wa / kawarazarikeri

attributes.title: 5bfc17dfa7372ae5b22441d9
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 長元八年関白左大臣歌合し侍けるのち、左方のかた人よろこひに住吉に詣て歌よみ侍けるに、左の頭にてよみ侍ける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 長元八年関白左大臣歌合し侍けるのち、左方のかた人よろこひに住吉に詣て歌よみ侍けるに、左の頭にてよみ侍ける
attributes.field_text: 住よしの / 浪も心を / よせけれは / むへそ汀に / たちまさりける
attributes.field_text_romaji: Sumiyoshi no / nami mo kokoro o / yosekereba / mube zo migiwa ni / tachimasarikeru
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Sumiyoshi no / nami mo kokoro o / yosekereba / mube zo migiwa ni / tachimasarikeru

attributes.title: 5bfc17dfa7372ae5b22441da
attributes.field_kotobagaki: おなし歌合に
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: おなし歌合に
attributes.field_text: 徒に / ふりぬる身をも / 住吉の / 松はさりとも / あはれしるらむ
attributes.field_text_romaji: itazura ni / furinuru mi o mo / Sumiyoshi no / matsu wa saritomo / aware shiruran
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: itazura ni / furinuru mi o mo / Sumiyoshi no / matsu wa saritomo / aware shiruran

attributes.title: 5bfc17dfa7372ae5b22441db
attributes.field_kotobagaki: おなし歌合（住吉の社の歌合）に
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: おなし歌合（住吉の社の歌合）に
attributes.field_text: 住吉の / 松のゆきあひの / ひまよりも / 月さえぬれは / 霜は置けり
attributes.field_text_romaji: Sumiyoshi no / matsu no yukiai no / hima yori mo / tsuki sae nureba / shimo wa okikeri
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Sumiyoshi no / matsu no yukiai no / hima yori mo / tsuki sae nureba / shimo wa okikeri

attributes.title: 5bfc17dfa7372ae5b22441dc
attributes.field_text: いはむや、すみよしの神はかたそぎのことの葉をのこし、伝教大師は我たつそまの思ひをのべ給へり。
attributes.field_text_romaji: iwamu ya, Sumiyoshi no kami wa katasogi no kotonoha o nokoshi, Dengyō daishi wa waga tatsu soma no omoi o nobetamaeri.
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: iwamu ya, Sumiyoshi no kami wa katasogi no kotonoha o nokoshi, Dengyō daishi wa waga tatsu soma no omoi o nobetamaeri.
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'Furthermore, the god of Sumiyoshi left behind the words “the ridge logs of the shrine roof,” and Dengyō daishi spoke of his feelings on “climbing the timbered mountain.”', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.XLIX'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17dfa7372ae5b22441dd
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 月前松風
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 月前松風
attributes.field_text: 月は猶 / もらぬ木のまも / 住吉の / 松をつくして / 秋かせそふく
attributes.field_text_romaji: tsuki wa nao / moranu ko no ma mo / Sumiyoshi no / matsu o tsukushite / akikaze zo fuku
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: tsuki wa nao / moranu ko no ma mo / Sumiyoshi no / matsu o tsukushite / akikaze zo fuku
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'still no moonlight can/  seep through the branches of pines/ at Sumiyoshi/ though the autumn wind rages/ attacking every last tree', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.172'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17dfa7372ae5b22441de
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 千五百番歌合に
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 千五百番歌合に
attributes.field_text: 我か道を / まもらは君を / まもるらむ / よはひはゆつれ / 住吉の松
attributes.field_text_romaji: waga michi o / mamoraba kimi o / mamoruran / yowai wa yuzure / Sumiyoshi no matsu
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: waga michi o / mamoraba kimi o / mamoruran / yowai wa yuzure / Sumiyoshi no matsu
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'if you offer your/ protection to our path \tyou must/ then favor our lord/ as well \tplease cede to him your/ years \tpine of Sumiyoshi', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.303-304'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17dfa7372ae5b22441df
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 住吉の / 恋忘草 / たねたえて / なき世にあへる / 我そかなしき
attributes.field_text_romaji: Sumiyoshi no / koi wasuregusa / tane taete / naki yo ni aeru / ware zo kanashiki
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Sumiyoshi no / koi wasuregusa / tane taete / naki yo ni aeru / ware zo kanashiki
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'how sad I am \tI/ who was born in this world where/ seeds of grasses of/ love’s forgetfulness no longer/ burgeon at Sumiyoshi', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.582'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17dfa7372ae5b22441e0
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 大弐三位、さとにいて侍にけるをきこしめして
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 大弐三位、さとにいて侍にけるをきこしめして
attributes.field_text: 待人は / 心ゆくとも / 住よしの / さとにとのみは / おもはさらなむ
attributes.field_text_romaji: matsu hito wa / kokoro yuku tomo / Sumiyoshi no / sato ni to nomi wa / omowazaranamu
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: matsu hito wa / kokoro yuku tomo / Sumiyoshi no / sato ni to nomi wa / omowazaranamu
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'although it may please/ the hearts of those who wait for/ you \tdo not think no/ other place as pleasant to live/  as Sumiyoshi village', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.657'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17dfa7372ae5b22441e1
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 御返し
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 御返し
attributes.field_text: 住吉の / 松はまつとも / おもほえて / 君か千年の / かけそ恋しき
attributes.field_text_romaji: Sumiyoshi no / matsu wa matsu tomo / omōede / kimi ga chitose no / kage zo koishiki
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Sumiyoshi no / matsu wa matsu tomo / omōede / kimi ga chitose no / kage zo koishiki
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'never could I feel/ the pines of Sumiyoshi/ were awaiting me/ I yearn still for the shelter of/ the thousand years of my lord', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.658'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17dfa7372ae5b22441e2
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: うきなから / ひさしくそ世を / 過にける / あはれやかけし / 住吉の松
attributes.field_text_romaji: uki nagara / hisashiku zo yo o / suginikeru / aware ya kakeshi / Sumiyoshi no matsu
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: uki nagara / hisashiku zo yo o / suginikeru / aware ya kakeshi / Sumiyoshi no matsu
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'though sorrow-laden/ I’ve languished these many years/ in this sad world \thave/ the pines of Sumiyoshi/ protected me all this time', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.728'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e0a7372ae5b22441e3
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 寛平御時きさいの宮の歌合のうた
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 寛平御時きさいの宮の歌合のうた
attributes.field_text: 浦ちかく / ふりくる雪は / 白浪の / 末の松山 / こすかとそみる
attributes.field_text_romaji: ura chikaku / furikuru yuki wa / shiranami no / Sue no matsuyama / kosuka to zo miru
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: ura chikaku / furikuru yuki wa / shiranami no / Sue no matsuyama / kosuka to zo miru
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'the swiftly driven/ snow \tfalling into rough drifts/ near the shore \tlooks like/ rows of crested waves crossing/ Suenomatsu Mountain', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.140'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e0a7372ae5b22441e4
attributes.field_text: 君をゝきて / あたし心を / わかもたは / 末の松山 / 浪もこえなん
attributes.field_text_romaji: kimi o okite / adashi gokoro o / waga motaba / Sue no matsuyama / nami mo koenan
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: kimi o okite / adashi gokoro o / waga motaba / Sue no matsuyama / nami mo koenan
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'if ever I should/ change my mind \tand banish you/ from my heart \tthen would/  great ocean waves rise and cross/ Suenomatsu Mountain', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.372'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e0a7372ae5b22441e5
attributes.field_text: あるは、松山の浪をかけ、野なかの水をくみ、秋はきのしたはをなかめ、あかつきのしきのはねかきをかそへ、
attributes.field_text_romaji: arui wa, Matsuyama no nami o kake, nonaka no mizu o kumi, akihagi no shitaba o nagame, akatsuki no shigi no habaki o kazoe
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: arui wa, Matsuyama no nami o kake, nonaka no mizu o kumi, akihagi no shitaba o nagame, akatsuki no shigi no habaki o kazoe

attributes.title: 5bfc17e0a7372ae5b22441e6
attributes.field_kotobagaki: おとこのもとにつかはしける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: おとこのもとにつかはしける
attributes.field_text: 我袖は / なにたつ末の / 松山か / ＊空より浪の / こえぬ日はなし / ＊４浦より浪のイ
attributes.field_text_romaji: waga sode wa / nani tatsu Sue no / matsuyama ka / sora yori nami no / koenu hi wa nashi
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: waga sode wa / nani tatsu Sue no / matsuyama ka / sora yori nami no / koenu hi wa nashi

attributes.title: 5bfc17e0a7372ae5b22441e7
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題しらず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題しらず
attributes.field_text: 浦ちかく / 降くる雪は / しら浪の / すゑのまつ山 / こすかとそみる
attributes.field_text_romaji: ura chikaku / furikuru yuki wa / shiranami no / Sue no matsuyama /  kosuka to zo miru
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: ura chikaku / furikuru yuki wa / shiranami no / Sue no matsuyama /  kosuka to zo miru

attributes.title: 5bfc17e0a7372ae5b22441e8
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 返し
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 返し
attributes.field_text: 我をのみ/たのむといはゝ/行末の/松のちよをも/君こそはみめ
attributes.field_text_romaji: ware o nomi / tanomu to iwaba / yuku Sue no / matsu no chiyo o mo  / kimi koso wa mime
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: ware o nomi / tanomu to iwaba / yuku Sue no / matsu no chiyo o mo  / kimi koso wa mime

attributes.title: 5bfc17e0a7372ae5b22441e9
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 源頼清朝臣みちのくにはてゝ、又肥後守になりてくたり侍けるを、いてたちの所にたれともなくてさしをかせ侍ける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 源頼清朝臣みちのくにはてゝ、又肥後守になりてくたり侍けるを、いてたちの所にたれともなくてさしをかせ侍ける
attributes.field_text: たひ＋＋の / ちよをはるかに / ＊君やへん / 末の松より / いきの松まて / ＊３君やみんイ
attributes.field_text_romaji: tabitabi no / chiyo o haruka ni / kimi ya hen / Sue no matsu yori / iki no matsu made /
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: tabitabi no / chiyo o haruka ni / kimi ya hen / Sue no matsu yori / iki no matsu made /
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'Journey piled on journey/ At a distance of a thousand years/ Will you see?/ From the pines of Sue,/ To the living pine groves.', 'source': 'McAuley, Thomas'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e0a7372ae5b22441ea
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 忍ひてかよふ女のまたこと人にものいふときゝてつかはしける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 忍ひてかよふ女のまたこと人にものいふときゝてつかはしける
attributes.field_text: こえにける / 浪をはしらて / すゑの松 / ちよまてとのみ / 頼みけるかな
attributes.field_text_romaji: koenikeru / nami oba shirade / Sue no matsu / chiyo made to nomi / tanomikeru kana
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: koenikeru / nami oba shirade / Sue no matsu / chiyo made to nomi / tanomikeru kana

attributes.title: 5bfc17e0a7372ae5b22441eb
attributes.field_kotobagaki: こゝろかはり侍りける女に人にかはりて
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: こゝろかはり侍りける女に人にかはりて
attributes.field_text: 契りきな / かたみに袖を / しほりつゝ / すゑの松山 / 浪こさしとは
attributes.field_text_romaji: chigiriki na / katami ni sode o / shibori tsutsu / Sue no matsuyama / nami kosaji to wa
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: chigiriki na / katami ni sode o / shibori tsutsu / Sue no matsuyama / nami kosaji to wa
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'Have you forgotten/  wringing tears from our sleeves  ̶   / vowing that our love/  would stand high above the waves/ like Pine Mountain in Sue?', 'source': 'Carter, Steven (1991): p.218'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e0a7372ae5b22441ec
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 百首歌のうちに雪の心をよめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 百首歌のうちに雪の心をよめる
attributes.field_text: いかにせん / 末の松山 / なみこさは / 峰の初雪 / きえもこそすれ
attributes.field_text_romaji: ikani sen / Sue no matsuyama / nami kosaba / mine no shirayuki / kie mo koso sure
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: ikani sen / Sue no matsuyama / nami kosaba / mine no shirayuki / kie mo koso sure
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'What am I to do?/ If upon the pine-clad peak of Sué/ The waves should break,/ The first snows upon the peak/ Would vanish clear away!', 'source': 'McAuley, Thomas'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e0a7372ae5b22441ed
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 後一条院御時、弘徽殿女御の歌合に祝の心をよめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 後一条院御時、弘徽殿女御の歌合に祝の心をよめる
attributes.field_text: 君か代は / 末の松山 / はる＋＋と / こすしら浪の / 数もしられす
attributes.field_text_romaji: kimi ga yo wa / Sue no matsuyama / harubaru to / kosu shiranami no / kazu mo shirarezu
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: kimi ga yo wa / Sue no matsuyama / harubaru to / kosu shiranami no / kazu mo shirarezu
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'Your Majesty’s reign:/ Upon the pine-clad peak of Sué,/ So distant/ Break whitecaps/ In numbers unknown to all!', 'source': 'McAuley, Thomas'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e0a7372ae5b22441ee
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 松風秋近といへる心をよめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 松風秋近といへる心をよめる
attributes.field_text: 秋風は/浪とゝもにや/こえぬらん/またき涼しき/末の松山
attributes.field_text_romaji: akikaze wa / nami to tomoni ya / koenu ran / madaki suzushiki / Sue no matsuyama
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: akikaze wa / nami to tomoni ya / koenu ran / madaki suzushiki / Sue no matsuyama

attributes.title: 5bfc17e0a7372ae5b22441ef
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 摂政太政大臣家百首歌合に、春曙といふ心をよみ侍ける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 摂政太政大臣家百首歌合に、春曙といふ心をよみ侍ける
attributes.field_text: 霞たつ / 末の松山 / ほの＋＋と / なみにはなるゝ / よこくもの空
attributes.field_text_romaji: kasumi tatsu / Sue no matsuyama / honobono to / nami ni hanaruru / yokogumo no sora
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: kasumi tatsu / Sue no matsuyama / honobono to / nami ni hanaruru / yokogumo no sora
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'heavy mist rises/ veiling Suenomatsu/ Mountain \tdimly seen/ breaking away from the waves/  clouds trail sideways in the sky', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.19'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e0a7372ae5b22441f0
attributes.field_kotobagaki: （土御門内大臣家にて、海辺歳暮といへる心をよめる）
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: （土御門内大臣家にて、海辺歳暮といへる心をよめる）
attributes.field_text: 老のなみ / こえける身こそ / あはれなれ / ことしも今は / 末の松山
attributes.field_text_romaji: oi no nami / koekeru mi koso / aware nare / kotoshi mo ima wa / Sue no matsuyama
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: oi no nami / koekeru mi koso / aware nare / kotoshi mo ima wa / Sue no matsuyama
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'waves of age have washed/  over this wrinkled body/ of mine \tpitifully/ awaiting another year’s end/ Suenomatsu Mountain', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.289'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e0a7372ae5b22441f1
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 千五百番歌合に
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 千五百番歌合に
attributes.field_text: 故郷に / たのめし人も / すゑの松 / まつらん袖に / 浪やこすらん
attributes.field_text_romaji: furusato ni / tanomeshi hito mo / Sue no matsu / matsuran sode ni / nami ya kosu ran
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: furusato ni / tanomeshi hito mo / Sue no matsu / matsuran sode ni / nami ya kosu ran
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'in my old home is/ one who vowed to wait for me/ Suenomatsu/ pines \tcan it be that waves now/ rise and flood across her sleeves', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.398'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e0a7372ae5b22441f2
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 橘為仲朝臣みちのおくに侍けるとき、歌あまたつかはしける中に
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 橘為仲朝臣みちのおくに侍けるとき、歌あまたつかはしける中に
attributes.field_text: しらなみの / こゆらん末の / 松山は / 花とやみゆる / 春の夜の月
attributes.field_text_romaji: shiranami  no / koyuran Sue no / matsuyama wa / hana to ya miyuru / haru no yo no tsuki
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: shiranami  no / koyuran Sue no / matsuyama wa / hana to ya miyuru / haru no yo no tsuki
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'white waves seem to roll/ across Suenomatsu/ Mountain \twhite caps seen/ as blossoms \tglowing beneath/ the bright moon of a spring night', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.605'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e0a7372ae5b22441fc
attributes.field_kotobagaki: なからのはしをよみめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: なからのはしをよみめる
attributes.field_text: くちにける / なからの橋を / きてみれは / あしの枯葉に / 秋風そ吹
attributes.field_text_romaji: kuchinikeru / Nagara no hashi o / kite mireba / ashi no kareha ni / akikaze zo fuku
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: kuchinikeru / Nagara no hashi o / kite mireba / ashi no kareha ni / akikaze zo fuku
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'On the Nagara Bridge//  I came to see its/ decaying ruins \tthat famous/ bridge of Nagara/ yet there’s only autumn wind/ blowing through the withered reeds', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.653'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e0a7372ae5b22441fd
attributes.field_kotobagaki: つのくににおはして、みきはのあしを見給て
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: つのくににおはして、みきはのあしを見給て
attributes.field_text: 津の国の / なからふへくも / あらぬかな / みしかきあしの / 世にこそ有けれ
attributes.field_text_romaji: Tsu no kuni no / nagaraubekumo aranu kana / mijikaki ashi no / yo ni koso arikere
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Tsu no kuni no / nagaraubekumo aranu kana / mijikaki ashi no / yo ni koso arikere
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'Viewing the reeds at the water’s edge in the province of Tsu//  surely I cannot/ linger in Nagara in/ the country of Tsu/ for this is a world where lives are/ short as the nodes of these reeds', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.749'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e0a7372ae5b22441fe
attributes.field_kotobagaki: なからのはしをよめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: なからのはしをよめる
attributes.field_text: 年ふれは / 朽こそまされ / 橋柱 / むかしなからの / 名たにかはらて
attributes.field_text_romaji: toshi fureba / kuchi koso masare / hashibashira / mukashi nagara no / na dani kawarade
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: toshi fureba / kuchi koso masare / hashibashira / mukashi nagara no / na dani kawarade
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'On the Nagara Bridge//  as the years pass by/ the posts beneath the bridge grow/ ever more decayed/ only the name “as it was”/ is unchanged from days of old', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.652'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e0a7372ae5b22441ff
attributes.field_kotobagaki: なからのはしをよめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: なからのはしをよめる
attributes.field_text: 春の日の / なからの浜に / 舟とめて / いつれかはしと / とへとこたへぬ
attributes.field_text_romaji: haru no hi no / Nagara no hama ni / fune tomete / izure ga hashi to  / toe to kotaenu
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: haru no hi no / Nagara no hama ni / fune tomete / izure ga hashi to  / toe to kotaenu
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'On the Nagara Bridge//  on a long spring day/ I tie my boat by the endless/ banks of Nagara/ River \twhere might that bridge be/  I ask \tbut no answer comes', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.652'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e0a7372ae5b2244202
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: はつせ川 / ふるかはのへに / ふたもとあるすき / 年をへて / 又もあひ見ん / 二もとあるすき
attributes.field_text_romaji: Hatsusegawa / furukawa nobe ni / futamoto aru sugi / toshi o hete / mata mo aimin / futamoto aru sugi
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Hatsusegawa / furukawa nobe ni / futamoto aru sugi / toshi o hete / mata mo aimin / futamoto aru sugi
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'Hatsuse River/ there by those ancient waters/ towering two-trunked cedar/ after years have passed/ once more we’ll meet \tyou and I/ towering two-trunked cedar', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.348'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e1a7372ae5b2244203
attributes.field_kotobagaki: ある人いやしきなとりて遠江国へまかるとて、はつせ川をわたるとてよみ侍ける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: ある人いやしきなとりて遠江国へまかるとて、はつせ川をわたるとてよみ侍ける
attributes.field_text: はつせ川 / わたるせさへや / にこるらん / よにすみかたき / 我身とおもへは
attributes.field_text_romaji: Hatsusegawa / wataru se sae ya / nigoruran / yo ni sumigataki / wagami to omoeba
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Hatsusegawa / wataru se sae ya / nigoruran / yo ni sumigataki / wagami to omoeba
attributes.field_volume: 巻第十九　離別　羈旅

attributes.title: 5bfc17e1a7372ae5b2244204
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 遥見山花といへる事をよめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 遥見山花といへる事をよめる
attributes.field_text: はつせ山 / 雲ゐに花の / 咲ぬれは / 天の河なみ / たつかとそみる
attributes.field_text_romaji: Hatsuseyama / kumoi ni hana no / sakinureba / ama no kawanami / tatsu ka to zo miru
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Hatsuseyama / kumoi ni hana no / sakinureba / ama no kawanami / tatsu ka to zo miru

attributes.title: 5bfc17e1a7372ae5b2244205
attributes.field_kotobagaki: きりをよめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: きりをよめる
attributes.field_text: 夕きりに / こすゑも見えす / 初せ山 / 入相のかねの / 音はかりして
attributes.field_text_romaji: yūgiri ni / kozue mo miezu / Hatsuseyama / iriai no kane no / oto bakari shite
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: yūgiri ni / kozue mo miezu / Hatsuseyama / iriai no kane no / oto bakari shite

attributes.title: 5bfc17e1a7372ae5b2244206
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 歌合し侍ける時、花の歌とてよめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 歌合し侍ける時、花の歌とてよめる
attributes.field_text: をはつせの / 花のさかりを / 見渡せは / 霞にまかふ / みねの白雲
attributes.field_text_romaji: Ohatsuse no / hana no sakari o / miwataseba / kasumi ni magau / mine no shirakumo
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Ohatsuse no / hana no sakari o / miwataseba / kasumi ni magau / mine no shirakumo

attributes.title: 5bfc17e1a7372ae5b2244207
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 権中納言俊忠家に恋の十首歌読侍ける時、いのれともあはさる恋といへる心を
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 権中納言俊忠家に恋の十首歌読侍ける時、いのれともあはさる恋といへる心を
attributes.field_text: うかりける / 人を初瀬の / 山おろしよ / はけしかれとは / 祈らぬ物を
attributes.field_text_romaji: ukarikeru / hito o Hatsuse no / yamaoroshi yo / hageshikare to wa / inoranu mono o
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: ukarikeru / hito o Hatsuse no / yamaoroshi yo / hageshikare to wa / inoranu mono o
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'You mountain wind-blasts/ blowing from Hase Temple:/ in my prayer I asked/ for you to sway her my way  ̶   / not to make her rebuffs more harsh.', 'source': 'Carter (1991): p.229'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e1a7372ae5b2244208
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 大宰大弐重家入道身まかりて後、山寺懐旧といへる心をよめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 大宰大弐重家入道身まかりて後、山寺懐旧といへる心をよめる
attributes.field_text: 初瀬山 / 入あひの鐘を / 聞たひに / むかしの遠く / 成そかなしき
attributes.field_text_romaji: Hatsuseyama / iriai no kane o / kiku tabi ni / mukashi no tōku / naru zo kanashi ki
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Hatsuseyama / iriai no kane o / kiku tabi ni / mukashi no tōku / naru zo kanashi ki

attributes.title: 5bfc17e1a7372ae5b2244209
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 長月のころ初瀬にまうてける道にてよみ侍ける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 長月のころ初瀬にまうてける道にてよみ侍ける
attributes.field_text: 初瀬山 / 夕こえくれて / 宿とへは / みわのひはらに / 秋風そふく
attributes.field_text_romaji: Hatsuseyama / yū koekurete / yado toeba / Miwa no hibara ni / akikaze zo fuku
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Hatsuseyama / yū koekurete / yado toeba / Miwa no hibara ni / akikaze zo fuku
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'crossing Hatsuse/ Mountain as evening darkens/ seeking some shelter/ on the cypress-dotted fields/ of Miwa \tautumn winds blow', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.396'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e1a7372ae5b224420a
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 摂政太政大臣家にて詩歌を合せけるに、水辺自秋涼といふ事をよみける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 摂政太政大臣家にて詩歌を合せけるに、水辺自秋涼といふ事をよみける
attributes.field_text: すすしさは / 秋やかへりて / 初瀬河 / ふるかは野への / 杉の下かけ
attributes.field_text_romaji: suzushisa wa / aki ya kaerite / Hatsusegawa / furukawa nobe no / sugi no shitakage
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: suzushisa wa / aki ya kaerite / Hatsusegawa / furukawa nobe no / sugi no shitakage
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'this welcome coolness/ can it mean autumn has returned/ Hatsuse River/ deep shade cast by cedars on/ the banks by ancient waters', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.115'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e1a7372ae5b224420b
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 入道前関白百首歌よませ侍けるとき、歳暮のこころをよみてつかはしける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 入道前関白百首歌よませ侍けるとき、歳暮のこころをよみてつかはしける
attributes.field_text: 石はしる / 初瀬の川の / なみ枕 / はやくもとしの / 暮にけるかな
attributes.field_text_romaji: ishi hashiru / Hatsuse no kawa no / namimakura / hayaku mo toshi no / kurenikeru kana
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: ishi hashiru / Hatsuse no kawa no / namimakura / hayaku mo toshi no / kurenikeru kana
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'hastening over/  the rocks \tHatsuse River/ waves murmuring by my/ pillow flow \tswiftly \tthis year/ has swept onward to its end', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.288-289'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e1a7372ae5b224420c
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 百首歌たてまつりし時
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 百首歌たてまつりし時
attributes.field_text: 初瀬山 / うつろふ花に / 春暮て / まかひし雲そ / みねに残れる
attributes.field_text_romaji: Hatsuseyama / utsurou hana ni / haru kurete / magaishi kumo zo / mine ni nokoreru
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Hatsuseyama / utsurou hana ni / haru kurete / magaishi kumo zo / mine ni nokoreru
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'in the fading blooms/ on Hatsuse Mountain \tspring/ draws to a close \tyet/ lingering on the peaks are/ the clouds we thought were flowers', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.70'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e1a7372ae5b224420d
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 家に百首歌合し侍けるに、祈恋といへる心を
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 家に百首歌合し侍けるに、祈恋といへる心を
attributes.field_text: 年もへぬ / いのる契は / はつせ山 / おのへのかねの / よその夕暮
attributes.field_text_romaji: toshi mo henu / inoru chigiri wa / Hatsuseyama / onoe no kane no / yoso no yūgure
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: toshi mo henu / inoru chigiri wa / Hatsuseyama / onoe no kane no / yoso no yūgure
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'as the years passed by/ my prayers for your vow of/  love died \ton the peak/  of Hatsuse the bell tolls \tnow/ evening belongs to others', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.472'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e1a7372ae5b224420e
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 守覚法親王五十首歌よませ侍ける時
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 守覚法親王五十首歌よませ侍ける時
attributes.field_text: 誰としも / しらぬ別の / かなしきは / 松浦のおきを / いつる船人
attributes.field_text_romaji: tare to shimo / shiranu wakare no / kanashiki wa / Matsura no oki o / izuru funabito
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: tare to shimo / shiranu wakare no / kanashiki wa / Matsura no oki o / izuru funabito
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'the deep sorrow of/ parting from someone who is/ a stranger to you  ̶   / passengers on a vessel/ leaving Matsura’s offing', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.364'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e1a7372ae5b224420f
attributes.field_kotobagaki: もろこしにて月をみてよみける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: もろこしにて月をみてよみける
attributes.field_text: あまの原 / ふりさけみれは / かすかなる / みかさの山に / 出し月かも
attributes.field_text_romaji: Amanohara / furisakemireba / Kasuga naru / Mikasa no yama ni / ideshi tsuki kamo
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Amanohara / furisakemireba / Kasuga naru / Mikasa no yama ni / ideshi tsuki kamo
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'I gaze across the/ endless plains of the sky \tcan/ that moon be the one/ that comes from the rim of Mount/ Mikasa in Kasuga', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.164'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e1a7372ae5b2244210
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 君かさす / みかさの山の / 紅葉はのいろ / 神な月 / 時雨の雨の / そめるなりけり
attributes.field_text_romaji: kimi ga sasu / Mikasa mo yama no / momijiba no iro / kannazuki / shigure no ame no / someru narikeri
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: kimi ga sasu / Mikasa mo yama no / momijiba no iro / kannazuki / shigure no ame no / someru narikeri
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'broad as my lord’s \tan/ umbrella of clouds stretches/ above Mikasa Mountain/ the brilliant autumn/ leaves have been dyed in harvest/ colors by the early winter drizzle', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.348'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e1a7372ae5b2244211
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 少将真忠かよひ侍ける所をさりてこと女につきて、それよりかすかの使に出たちてまかりけれは
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 少将真忠かよひ侍ける所をさりてこと女につきて、それよりかすかの使に出たちてまかりけれは
attributes.field_text: 空しらぬ / 雨にもぬるる / 我身哉 / みかさの山を / よそにききつつ
attributes.field_text_romaji: sora shiranu / ame ni mo nururu / wagami kana / Mikasa no yama o / yosoni kiki tsutsu
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: sora shiranu / ame ni mo nururu / wagami kana / Mikasa no yama o / yosoni kiki tsutsu

attributes.title: 5bfc17e1a7372ae5b2244212
attributes.field_kotobagaki: おとこのもとに、雨ふる夜、かさをやりてよひけれと、こさりけれは
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: おとこのもとに、雨ふる夜、かさをやりてよひけれと、こさりけれは
attributes.field_text: さしてこと / 思ひし物を / みかさ山 / かひなく雨の / もりにけるかな /
attributes.field_text_romaji: sashite ko to / omoishi mono o / Mikasayama / kai naku ame no / mori ni keru kana
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: sashite ko to / omoishi mono o / Mikasayama / kai naku ame no / mori ni keru kana

attributes.title: 5bfc17e1a7372ae5b2244213
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 兼輔朝臣、宰相中将より中納言になりて又のとし、のりゆみのかへりたちのあるしにまかりて、これかれ思ひをのふるついてに
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 兼輔朝臣、宰相中将より中納言になりて又のとし、のりゆみのかへりたちのあるしにまかりて、これかれ思ひをのふるついてに
attributes.field_text: ふるさとの / みかさの山は / 遠けれと / こゑはむかしの / うとからぬかな /
attributes.field_text_romaji: furusato no / Mikasa no yamaｗa / tōkeredo / koe wa mukashi no / utokaranu kana
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: furusato no / Mikasa no yamaｗa / tōkeredo / koe wa mukashi no / utokaranu kana

attributes.title: 5bfc17e1a7372ae5b2244214
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 天暦のみかと四十になりおはしましける時、山階てらに金泥寿命経四十八巻をかき、供養したてまつりて、御巻数鶴にくはせて、すはまにたてたりけり、そのすはまのしき物に、あまたの歌あしてにかける中に
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 天暦のみかと四十になりおはしましける時、山階てらに金泥寿命経四十八巻をかき、供養したてまつりて、御巻数鶴にくはせて、すはまにたてたりけり、そのすはまのしき物に、あまたの歌あしてにかける中に
attributes.field_text: 声たかく / みかさの山そ / よはふなる / ＊あめのしたこそ / たのしかるらし / ＊４あめかしたこそイ
attributes.field_text_romaji: koe takaku / Mikasa no yama zo / yobau naru / ame no shita koso / tanoshikaru rashi
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: koe takaku / Mikasa no yama zo / yobau naru / ame no shita koso / tanoshikaru rashi

attributes.title: 5bfc17e1a7372ae5b2244215
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 名のみして / 山はみかさも / なかりけり / あさひ夕日の / さすをいふかも /
attributes.field_text_romaji: na nomi shite / yama wa Mikasa mo / nakari keri / asahi yūhi no / sasu o iu kamo
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: na nomi shite / yama wa Mikasa mo / nakari keri / asahi yūhi no / sasu o iu kamo

attributes.title: 5bfc17e1a7372ae5b2244216
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 桜はな / みかさの山の / かけしあれは / 雪とふれとも / ぬれしとそ思
attributes.field_text_romaji: sakurabana / Mikasa no yama no / kage shi areba / yuki to furedomo / nureji to zo omou
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: sakurabana / Mikasa no yama no / kage shi areba / yuki to furedomo / nureji to zo omou

attributes.title: 5bfc17e1a7372ae5b2244217
attributes.field_kotobagaki: おなし少将かよひ侍ける所に、兵部卿致平のみこまかりて、少将のきみおはしたりといはせ侍けるを、後に聞て、かのみこのもとにつかはしける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: おなし少将かよひ侍ける所に、兵部卿致平のみこまかりて、少将のきみおはしたりといはせ侍けるを、後に聞て、かのみこのもとにつかはしける
attributes.field_text: あやしくも / 我ぬれ衣を / きたるかな / みかさの山を / 人にかられて
attributes.field_text_romaji: ayashiku mo / waga nureginu o / kitaru kana / Mikasa no yama o / hito ni kararete
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: ayashiku mo / waga nureginu o / kitaru kana / Mikasa no yama o / hito ni kararete

attributes.title: 5bfc17e1a7372ae5b2244218
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 二条前太政大臣少将に侍ける時かすかのつかひにまかりて、又の日霧のいみしうたち侍けれは入道前太政大臣のもとにつかはしける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 二条前太政大臣少将に侍ける時かすかのつかひにまかりて、又の日霧のいみしうたち侍けれは入道前太政大臣のもとにつかはしける
attributes.field_text: みかさ山 / かすかの原の / あさ霧に / かへりたつらん / ＊今朝をこそまて / ＊５そらをこそまてイ
attributes.field_text_romaji: Mikasayama / Kasuga no hara no / asagiri ni / kaeri tatsuran / kesa o koso mate
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Mikasayama / Kasuga no hara no / asagiri ni / kaeri tatsuran / kesa o koso mate

attributes.title: 5bfc17e1a7372ae5b2244219
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 後冷泉院御時きさいの宮の歌合に、春日のまつりをよみ侍りける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 後冷泉院御時きさいの宮の歌合に、春日のまつりをよみ侍りける
attributes.field_text: けふまつる / みかさの山の / 神ませは / あめのしたには / 君そさかへん
attributes.field_text_romaji: kyō matsuru / Mikasa no yama no / kami maseba / ame no shita ni wa / kimi zo sakaen
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: kyō matsuru / Mikasa no yama no / kami maseba / ame no shita ni wa / kimi zo sakaen

attributes.title: 5bfc17e1a7372ae5b224421a
attributes.field_kotobagaki: おとこのものいひ侍ける女を今はさらにいかしといひて後、雨のいたくふりけるにまかりけりとききてつかはしける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: おとこのものいひ侍ける女を今はさらにいかしといひて後、雨のいたくふりけるにまかりけりとききてつかはしける
attributes.field_text: みかさ山 / さしはなれぬと / ききしかと / 雨もよにとは / 思ひしものを
attributes.field_text_romaji: Mikasayama / sashihanarenu to / kikishikado / ame mo yo ni to wa / omoishi mono o
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Mikasayama / sashihanarenu to / kikishikado / ame mo yo ni to wa / omoishi mono o
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'The Mount of Mikasa/ Is very far from you,/ I’d heard;/ Surely, not in such rain,/ Or so I did think!', 'source': 'McAuley, Thomas'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e1a7372ae5b224421b
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 山階寺供養の後、宇治前太政大臣のもとにつかはしける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 山階寺供養の後、宇治前太政大臣のもとにつかはしける
attributes.field_text: ふかきうみの / ちかひはしらす / みかさ山 / 心たかくも / みえしきみ哉
attributes.field_text_romaji: fukaki umi no / chikai wa shirazu / Mikasayama / kokoro takaku mo / mieshi kimi kana
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: fukaki umi no / chikai wa shirazu / Mikasayama / kokoro takaku mo / mieshi kimi kana

attributes.title: 5bfc17e1a7372ae5b224421c
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 摂政左大臣中将にて侍けるころ、春日祭使にくたりけるに、周防内侍女使にてくたりけるに、為隆卿行事弁にて侍りけるかもとにつかはしける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 摂政左大臣中将にて侍けるころ、春日祭使にくたりけるに、周防内侍女使にてくたりけるに、為隆卿行事弁にて侍りけるかもとにつかはしける
attributes.field_text: いかはかり / 神も哀と / みかさ山 / ふたはの松の / 千よのけしきを
attributes.field_text_romaji: ikabakari / kami mo aware to / Mikasayama / futaba no matsu no / chiyo no keshiki o
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: ikabakari / kami mo aware to / Mikasayama / futaba no matsu no / chiyo no keshiki o

attributes.title: 5bfc17e1a7372ae5b224421d
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 大皇大后宮の扇合に月の心をよめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 大皇大后宮の扇合に月の心をよめる
attributes.field_text: みかさ山 / みねより出る / 月影は / さほの河せの / 氷なりけり
attributes.field_text_romaji: Mikasayama / mine yori izuru / tsugikage wa / Saho no kawase no / kōri narikeri
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Mikasayama / mine yori izuru / tsugikage wa / Saho no kawase no / kōri narikeri

attributes.title: 5bfc17e1a7372ae5b224421e
attributes.field_kotobagaki: ならの花林院の歌合に月をよめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: ならの花林院の歌合に月をよめる
attributes.field_text: いかなれは / 秋はひかりの / まさるらむ / おなしみかさの / 山のはの月
attributes.field_text_romaji: ika nareba / aki wa hikari no / masaruran / onaji Mikasa no / yama no ha no tsuki
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: ika nareba / aki wa hikari no / masaruran / onaji Mikasa no / yama no ha no tsuki

attributes.title: 5bfc17e1a7372ae5b224421f
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 八月十五夜に人人歌よみけるによめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 八月十五夜に人人歌よみけるによめる
attributes.field_text: みかさ山 / ひかりをさして / 出しより / くもらて明ぬ / 秋の夜の月
attributes.field_text_romaji: Mikasayama / hikari o sashite / ideshi yori / kumorade akenu / aki no yo no tsuki
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Mikasayama / hikari o sashite / ideshi yori / kumorade akenu / aki no yo no tsuki

attributes.title: 5bfc17e1a7372ae5b2244220
attributes.field_kotobagaki: ならの花林院の歌合に月をよめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: ならの花林院の歌合に月をよめる
attributes.field_text: 三笠山 / もりくる月の / きよけれは / 神の慮も / すみやしぬらん
attributes.field_text_romaji: Mikasayama / morikuru tsuki no / kiyokereba / kami no hakari mo / sumi ya shinuran
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Mikasayama / morikuru tsuki no / kiyokereba / kami no hakari mo / sumi ya shinuran
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'Onto Mikasa mountain/ Drips the moon/ So clear that/ The god’s own heart/ Is clear, I think.', 'source': 'McAuley, Thomas'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e1a7372ae5b2244221
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 宇治前太政大臣家の歌合に祝の心をよめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 宇治前太政大臣家の歌合に祝の心をよめる
attributes.field_text: きみか代は / ＊くもりもあらし / みかさ山 / みねに朝日の / ささん限は / ＊２かきりもあらしイ
attributes.field_text_romaji: kimi ga yo wa / kumori mo araji / Mikasayama / mine ni asahi no / sasan kagiri wa
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: kimi ga yo wa / kumori mo araji / Mikasayama / mine ni asahi no / sasan kagiri wa

attributes.title: 5bfc17e2a7372ae5b2244222
attributes.field_kotobagaki: したしき人の春日にまいりて、鹿のありつるよしなと申けるをききてよめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: したしき人の春日にまいりて、鹿のありつるよしなと申けるをききてよめる
attributes.field_text: 三笠山 / 神のしるしの / いちしるく / しかありけりと / 聞そうれしき
attributes.field_text_romaji: Mikasayama / kami no shirushi no / ichijiruku / shika arikeri to / kiku zo ureshiki
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Mikasayama / kami no shirushi no / ichijiruku / shika arikeri to / kiku zo ureshiki

attributes.title: 5bfc17e2a7372ae5b2244223
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 左京大夫顕輔、中宮亮にて侍ける時、下臈にこえらるへしとききて、宮の女房の中になけき申たりける返事に、たれとはなくて
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 左京大夫顕輔、中宮亮にて侍ける時、下臈にこえらるへしとききて、宮の女房の中になけき申たりける返事に、たれとはなくて
attributes.field_text: よの中を / おもひないりそ / みかさ山 / さし出る月の / すまむ限は
attributes.field_text_romaji: yo no naka o / omoi na iri so / Mikasayama / sashiizuru tsuki no / sumamu kagiri wa
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: yo no naka o / omoi na iri so / Mikasayama / sashiizuru tsuki no / sumamu kagiri wa

attributes.title: 5bfc17e2a7372ae5b2244224
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 山しな寺にまかりたりけるに、宗延法師にあひてよもすから物いひ侍けるに、あり明の月のみかさ山よりさしのほりけるを見てよめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 山しな寺にまかりたりけるに、宗延法師にあひてよもすから物いひ侍けるに、あり明の月のみかさ山よりさしのほりけるを見てよめる
attributes.field_text: なからへは / おもひてにせむ / 思ひ出よ / 君とみかさの / 山のはの月
attributes.field_text_romaji: nagaraeba / omoide ni semu / omoiide yo / kimi to Mikasa no / yama no ha no tsuki
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: nagaraeba / omoide ni semu / omoiide yo / kimi to Mikasa no / yama no ha no tsuki

attributes.title: 5bfc17e2a7372ae5b2244225
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 後二条関白、はかなきことにてむつかり侍けれは、家の中には侍なから、まへへもさしいて侍らて、女房の中にいひ入侍ける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 後二条関白、はかなきことにてむつかり侍けれは、家の中には侍なから、まへへもさしいて侍らて、女房の中にいひ入侍ける
attributes.field_text: みかさ山 / さすかにかけに / かくろへて / ふるかひもなき / あめのしたかな
attributes.field_text_romaji: Mikasayama / sasuga ni kage ni / kakuroete / furu kai mo naki / ame no shita kana
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Mikasayama / sasuga ni kage ni / kakuroete / furu kai mo naki / ame no shita kana
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'On Mount Mikasa/ Indeed, by the shade/ I am concealed, yet/ Continuing on seems pointless/ Under such a rain.', 'source': 'McAuley, Thomas'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e2a7372ae5b2244226
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 後一条院の御時、はしめて春日社に行幸ありけるに、一条院の御時の例をおほしめしいたさせ給ふてよませ給ふける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 後一条院の御時、はしめて春日社に行幸ありけるに、一条院の御時の例をおほしめしいたさせ給ふてよませ給ふける
attributes.field_text: 三笠山 / さして来にけり / 磯の神 / ふるき御幸の / 跡をたつねて
attributes.field_text_romaji: Mikasayama / sashite kinikeri / iso no kami / furuki miyuki no / ato o tazunete
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Mikasayama / sashite kinikeri / iso no kami / furuki miyuki no / ato o tazunete

attributes.title: 5bfc17e2a7372ae5b2244227
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 百首歌めしける時、神祇歌とてよませ給ふける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 百首歌めしける時、神祇歌とてよませ給ふける
attributes.field_text: 天のした / のとけかれとや / 榊葉を / 御笠の山に / さしはしめけん
attributes.field_text_romaji: ame no shita / nodokekare to ya / sakakiba o / Mikasa no yama ni / sashihajimeken
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: ame no shita / nodokekare to ya / sakakiba o / Mikasa no yama ni / sashihajimeken

attributes.title: 5bfc17e2a7372ae5b2244228
attributes.field_kotobagaki: ふみつかはしける女に、おなしつかさのかみなりける人かよふとききて、つかはしける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: ふみつかはしける女に、おなしつかさのかみなりける人かよふとききて、つかはしける
attributes.field_text: 白雲の / 嶺にしもなと / かよふらん / おなしみかさの / 山の麓を
attributes.field_text_romaji: shirakumo no / mine ni shimo nado / kayouran / onaji Mikasa no / yama no fumoto o
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: shirakumo no / mine ni shimo nado / kayouran / onaji Mikasa no / yama no fumoto o
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'why is it that those/  white clouds make their way up to/ Mikasa’s peak when/ They could tarry here in/  The foothills of the mountains', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.415'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e2a7372ae5b2244229
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 家に百首歌よみはへりけるとき、神祇のこころを
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 家に百首歌よみはへりけるとき、神祇のこころを
attributes.field_text: 天の下 / みかさの山の / かけならて / たのむかたなき / 身とはしらすや
attributes.field_text_romaji: ame no shita / Mikasa no yama no / kage narade / tanomu kata naki / mi towa shirazu ya
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: ame no shita / Mikasa no yama no / kage narade / tanomu kata naki / mi towa shirazu ya
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'under rainy skies/ aside from the shelter of/  Umbrella Mountain/ no protection do I/ receive \tdo you not know this', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.770'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e2a7372ae5b224422a
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 秋風の / 吹とふきぬる / むさし野は / なへて草はの / 色かはりけり
attributes.field_text_romaji: akikaze no / fuku to fukinuru / Musashino wa / nabete kusaba no / iro kawarikeri
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: akikaze no / fuku to fukinuru / Musashino wa / nabete kusaba no / iro kawarikeri
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'on Musashi Moor/ where autumn winds whistle in/ cold unending blasts/ no blade of grass is spared  ̶  / the color of each transformed', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.284'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e2a7372ae5b224422b
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: むらさきの / ひともとゆへに / むさしのの / 草はみなから / 哀とそ見る
attributes.field_text_romaji: murasaki no / hitomoto yue ni / Musashino no / kusa wa minagara / aware to zo miru
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: murasaki no / hitomoto yue ni / Musashino no / kusa wa minagara / aware to zo miru
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'a single stalk of/ royal purple upon the/ Moor of Musashi/ makes me love all the other/ wild grasses all the more', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.298'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e2a7372ae5b224422c
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 延喜御時秋歌めしありけれは奉ける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 延喜御時秋歌めしありけれは奉ける
attributes.field_text: 女郎花 / にほへる秋の / むさし野は / つねよりも猶 / むつましき哉
attributes.field_text_romaji: ominaeshi / nioeru aki no / Musashino wa / tsune yori mo nao / mutsumajiki kana
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: ominaeshi / nioeru aki no / Musashino wa / tsune yori mo nao / mutsumajiki kana
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'Musashino field/ In autumn, with the scent of/  Patrinia blooms/ More so than at other times/  Longing for it consumes me!', 'source': 'Kern, J. Christopher'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e2a7372ae5b224422d
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: むさし野は / 袖ひつはかり / 分しかと / わかむらさきは / たつね侘にき
attributes.field_text_romaji: Musashino wa / sode hitsu bakari / wakeshikado / wakamurasaki wa / tazunewabiniki
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Musashino wa / sode hitsu bakari / wakeshikado / wakamurasaki wa / tazunewabiniki

attributes.title: 5bfc17e2a7372ae5b224422e
attributes.field_kotobagaki: さくなむさ
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: さくなむさ
attributes.field_text: むらさきの / 色にはさくな / むさしのの / 草のゆかりと / 人もこそしれ
attributes.field_text_romaji: murasaki no / iro ni wa sakuna / Musashino no / kusa no yukari to / hito mo koso shire
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: murasaki no / iro ni wa sakuna / Musashino no / kusa no yukari to / hito mo koso shire

attributes.title: 5bfc17e2a7372ae5b224422f
attributes.field_kotobagaki: おなし屏風にむさしののかたかきて侍けるをよめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: おなし屏風にむさしののかたかきて侍けるをよめる
attributes.field_text: むさしのを / きりの晴まに / 見わたせは / 行末遠き / 心ちこそすれ
attributes.field_text_romaji: Musashino o / kiri no harema ni / miwatase ba / yukusue tōki / kokochi koso sure
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Musashino o / kiri no harema ni / miwatase ba / yukusue tōki / kokochi koso sure

attributes.title: 5bfc17e2a7372ae5b2244230
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 法師品、漸見湿土泥決定知近水の心をよみ侍ける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 法師品、漸見湿土泥決定知近水の心をよみ侍ける
attributes.field_text: むさしのの / ほりかねの井も / ある物を / うれしくも水の / ちかつきにけり
attributes.field_text_romaji: Musashino no / Horikane no i mo / arumono o / ureshikumo mizu no / chikazukinikeri
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Musashino no / Horikane no i mo / arumono o / ureshikumo mizu no / chikazukinikeri

attributes.title: 5bfc17e2a7372ae5b2244231
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 水無瀬にて、十首歌たてまつりし時
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 水無瀬にて、十首歌たてまつりし時
attributes.field_text: 武蔵野や / ゆけとも秋の / はてそなき / いかなる風の / 末に吹らん
attributes.field_text_romaji: Musashino ya / yukedomo aki no / hate zo naki / ikanaru kaze no / sue ni fukuran
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Musashino ya / yukedomo aki no / hate zo naki / ikanaru kaze no / sue ni fukuran
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'ah \tMusashi Moor/ no matter how far I go/ there is no end to/ autumn \twhat wind is it that/ blows tips of distant grasses', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.164'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e2a7372ae5b2244232
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 五十首歌たてまつりけるに、野径月
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 五十首歌たてまつりけるに、野径月
attributes.field_text: 行末は / 空もひとつの / 武蔵野に / 草の原より / いつる月かけ
attributes.field_text_romaji: yukusue wa / sora mo hitotsu no / Musashino ni / kusa no hara yori / izuru tsukikage
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: yukusue wa / sora mo hitotsu no / Musashino ni / kusa no hara yori / izuru tsukikage
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'my destination/ and the sky become one on/ Musashi Moor/ where from distant field grasses/  there emerges bright moonlight', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.181'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e2a7372ae5b2244233
attributes.field_kotobagaki: みちのくうた
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: みちのくうた
attributes.field_text: もかみ川 / のほれは下る / いな舟の / いなにはあらす / この月はかり
attributes.field_text_romaji: Mogamigawa / noboreba kudaru / inabune no / ina ni wa arazu / kono tsuki bakari
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Mogamigawa / noboreba kudaru / inabune no / ina ni wa arazu / kono tsuki bakari
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'as the rice boats ply/ the Mogami River \tthey/ pole upstream and back  ̶   / you too should come again \tit’s/ only this month I say “no”', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.372'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e2a7372ae5b2244234
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 堀川院御時、百首歌奉りける時、述懐の歌によみてたてまつりける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 堀川院御時、百首歌奉りける時、述懐の歌によみてたてまつりける
attributes.field_text: もかみ河 / 瀬瀬の岩かと / わきかへり
attributes.field_text_romaji: Mogamigawa / seze no iwa ka to / wakikaeri
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Mogamigawa / seze no iwa ka to / wakikaeri

attributes.title: 5bfc17e2a7372ae5b2244235
attributes.field_kotobagaki: あふさかにて人をわかれける時によめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: あふさかにて人をわかれける時によめる
attributes.field_text: 相坂の/ 関しまさしき / 物ならは / あかすわかるる / 君をととめよ
attributes.field_text_romaji: Ausaka no / sekishi masashiki / mono naraba / akazu wakaruru / kimi o todome yo
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Ausaka no / sekishi masashiki / mono naraba / akazu wakaruru / kimi o todome yo
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'oh barrier of / Ōsaka \tif restraint/ indeed you are \thold/ back that one who wishes to/ leave before farewells are done', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.154'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e2a7372ae5b2244236
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 藤原のこれをかかむさしのすけにまかりける時に、をくりにあふさかをこゆとてよみける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 藤原のこれをかかむさしのすけにまかりける時に、をくりにあふさかをこゆとてよみける
attributes.field_text: かつこえて / 別れもゆくか / 相坂は / 人たのめなる / なにこそ有けれ
attributes.field_text_romaji: Katsu koete / wakare mo yuku ka / Ausaka wa / hitodanome naru / na ni koso arikere
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Katsu koete / wakare mo yuku ka / Ausaka wa / hitodanome naru / na ni koso arikere
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'while still he crosses/ over and journeys onward/ leaving me behind/ your title \tŌsaka/ Meeting Hill \tis just a name', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.159'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e2a7372ae5b2244237
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 音羽山/ をとにききつつ / 相坂の / 関のこなたに / 年をふる哉
attributes.field_text_romaji: Otowayama / oto ni kikitsutsu / Ausaka no / seki no konata ni / toshi o furu kana
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Otowayama / oto ni kikitsutsu / Ausaka no / seki no konata ni / toshi o furu kana
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'I hear rumors of/ her \tborne by Mount Sound of Wings/ and yet here on the/  far side of Meeting Hill I/ pass the years in barren dreams', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.184'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e2a7372ae5b2244238
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 逢坂の / ゆふつけ鳥も / 我ことく / 人や恋しき / ねのみ鳴らん
attributes.field_text_romaji: Ausaka no / yūtsugedori mo / waga gotoku / hitoya koishiki / ne nomi nakuran
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Ausaka no / yūtsugedori mo / waga gotoku / hitoya koishiki / ne nomi nakuran
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'does the beribboned/ cock of Meeting Hill share my/ unfulfilled longings  ̶ / is it for love alone that/ we raise our solemn voices', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.202'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e2a7372ae5b2244239
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: あふさかの / 関になかるる / いはし水 / いはて心に / おもひこそすれ
attributes.field_text_romaji: Ausaka no / seki ni nagaruru / iwashimizu / iwa de kokoro ni / omoi koso sure
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Ausaka no / seki ni nagaruru / iwashimizu / iwa de kokoro ni / omoi koso sure
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'the fresh spring waters/ surge freely through the rocky/ crevices of the/ Barrier at Meeting Hill \tbut/ My words of love remain checked', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.203'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e2a7372ae5b224423a
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 恋恋て / 稀にこよひそ / 逢坂の / 夕つけ鳥は / なかすもあら南
attributes.field_text_romaji: Koi koi te / mare ni koyoi zo / Ausaka no / yūtsugedori wa / nakazu mo aranan
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Koi koi te / mare ni koyoi zo / Ausaka no / yūtsugedori wa / nakazu mo aranan
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'I have yearned so long/ and at last tonight we meet  ̶ / may the beribboned/ cock at Ōsaka never/ announce the break of day', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.231'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e2a7372ae5b224423b
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 中納言源ののほるの朝臣のあふみのすけに侍ける時に、よみてやれりける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 中納言源ののほるの朝臣のあふみのすけに侍ける時に、よみてやれりける
attributes.field_text: 相坂の / 夕つけとりに / あらはこそ / 君かゆききを / なくなくも見め
attributes.field_text_romaji: Ausaka no / yūtsugedori ni / araba koso / kimi ga yukiki o / nakunaku mo mime
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Ausaka no / yūtsugedori ni / araba koso / kimi ga yukiki o / nakunaku mo mime
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'oh if I could be/ the beribboned cock of the/ Ōsaka Road \thow/ plaintively I would cry out/ as I watched you come and go', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.261-262'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e2a7372ae5b224423c
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 逢坂の / 嵐のかせは / さむけれと / 行ゑしらねは / 侘つつそぬる
attributes.field_text_romaji: Ausaka no / arashi no kaze wa / samukeredo / yukue shiraneba / wabitsutsu zo nuru
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Ausaka no / arashi no kaze wa / samukeredo / yukue shiraneba / wabitsutsu zo nuru
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'in Ōsaka/ the howling tempests rage and/  winds lash cold \tbut still/ I know no place to go \tso/  I’ll sleep here in misery', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.333'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e2a7372ae5b224423d
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 奥山菅の根しのきふる雪下
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 奥山菅の根しのきふる雪下
attributes.field_text: ＊わきもこす / あふさか山の / しのすすき / ほには出すも / 恋わたる哉/＊１わきもこかイ/＊１わきもこにイ
attributes.field_text_romaji: Wagimo kosu / Ausaka yama no / shinosusuki / ho ni wa idezu mo / koi wataru kana
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Wagimo kosu / Ausaka yama no / shinosusuki / ho ni wa idezu mo / koi wataru kana
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'my passion shall stay/ hidden as the unopened/ buds of plume grasses/  on the Ōsaka slopes/ where I met my beloved', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.376-377'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e2a7372ae5b224423e
attributes.field_text: 夏草を見て、妻を恋ひ、逢坂山に至りて、手向けを祈り、
attributes.field_text_romaji: natsukusa o mite, tsuma o koi, Ausaka yama ni itarite, tamuke o inori,…
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: natsukusa o mite, tsuma o koi, Ausaka yama ni itarite, tamuke o inori,…
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': '[…] on yearning for one’s wife when one sees […] the grasses of summer, on offering prayer stripes on Ōsaka Hill, […]', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.47'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e2a7372ae5b224423f
attributes.field_kotobagaki: おとこのかれはてぬに、ことおとこをあひしりて侍けるに、もとのおとこの東へまかりけるをききてつかはしける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: おとこのかれはてぬに、ことおとこをあひしりて侍けるに、もとのおとこの東へまかりけるをききてつかはしける
attributes.field_text: ありとたに / きくへき物を / あふさかの / 関のあなたそ / はるけかりける
attributes.field_text_romaji: ari to dani / kikubeki mono o / Ausaka no / seki no anata zo / harukekarikeru
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: ari to dani / kikubeki mono o / Ausaka no / seki no anata zo / harukekarikeru

attributes.title: 5bfc17e2a7372ae5b2244240
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 返し
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 返し
attributes.field_text: 関守は / あらたまるてふ / あふ坂の / ゆふつけとりは / 鳴つつそ行
attributes.field_text_romaji: sekimori wa / aratamaru chō / Ausaka no / yūtsugedori wa / nakitsutsu zo yuku
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: sekimori wa / aratamaru chō / Ausaka no / yūtsugedori wa / nakitsutsu zo yuku

attributes.title: 5bfc17e2a7372ae5b2244241
attributes.field_kotobagaki: あひにける女の、またあはさりけれは
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: あひにける女の、またあはさりけれは
attributes.field_text: しらさりし / 時たにこえし / あふ坂を / なと今さらに / 我まとふらん
attributes.field_text_romaji: shirazarishi / toki dani koeshi / Ausaka o / nado ima sara ni / ware madouran
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: shirazarishi / toki dani koeshi / Ausaka o / nado ima sara ni / ware madouran

attributes.title: 5bfc17e3a7372ae5b2244242
attributes.field_kotobagaki: やまひし侍てあふみのせきてらにこもりて侍けるに、まへのみちより閑院のこいし山にまうてけるを、たた今なんゆきすきぬる、と人のつけ侍けれは、をひてつかはしける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: やまひし侍てあふみのせきてらにこもりて侍けるに、まへのみちより閑院のこいし山にまうてけるを、たた今なんゆきすきぬる、と人のつけ侍けれは、をひてつかはしける
attributes.field_text: あふさかの / ゆふつけになく / 鳥の音を / 聞とかめすそ / 行過にける
attributes.field_text_romaji: Ausaka no / yūtsuge ni naku / tori no ne o / kikitogamezu zo / yukisuginikeru
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Ausaka no / yūtsuge ni naku / tori no ne o / kikitogamezu zo / yukisuginikeru

attributes.title: 5bfc17e3a7372ae5b2244243
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 思ひやる / 心はつねに / かよへとも / あふ坂の関 / こえすもあるかな
attributes.field_text_romaji: omoiyaru / kokoro wa tsune ni / kayoedomo / Ausaka no seki / koezu mo aru kana
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: omoiyaru / kokoro wa tsune ni / kayoedomo / Ausaka no seki / koezu mo aru kana
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'Sent out on my thoughts/  My heart is always able/ To pass through it, but/  The gate of the Meeting Slope/  It seems that I can’t get through.', 'source': 'Kern, J. Christopher'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e3a7372ae5b2244244
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 女のもとにつかはしける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 女のもとにつかはしける
attributes.field_text: 人しれぬ / 身はいそけとも / としをへて / なとこえかたき / あふさかの関
attributes.field_text_romaji: hito shirenu / mi wa isogedomo / toshi o hete / nado koegataki / Ausaka no seki
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: hito shirenu / mi wa isogedomo / toshi o hete / nado koegataki / Ausaka no seki

attributes.title: 5bfc17e3a7372ae5b2244245
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 返し
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 返し
attributes.field_text: 東路に / 行かふ人に / あらぬ身は / いつかはこえん / あふさかの関
attributes.field_text_romaji: Azumaji ni / yukikau hito ni / aranu mi wa / itsuka wa koen / Ausaka no seki
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Azumaji ni / yukikau hito ni / aranu mi wa / itsuka wa koen / Ausaka no seki

attributes.title: 5bfc17e3a7372ae5b2244246
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 返し
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 返し
attributes.field_text: 道しらて / やみやはしなぬ / あふ坂の / 関のこなたは / うみといふなり
attributes.field_text_romaji: michi shirade / yami ya wa shinanu / Ausaka no / seki no konata wa / umi to iu nari
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: michi shirade / yami ya wa shinanu / Ausaka no / seki no konata wa / umi to iu nari

attributes.title: 5bfc17e3a7372ae5b2244247
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 返し
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 返し
attributes.field_text: 近けれは / なにかはしるし / あふさかの / 関の外そと / 思ひたえなん
attributes.field_text_romaji: chikakereba / nanika wa shirushi / Ausaka no / sekino soto zoto / omoitaenan
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: chikakereba / nanika wa shirushi / Ausaka no / sekino soto zoto / omoitaenan

attributes.title: 5bfc17e3a7372ae5b2244248
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 返し
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 返し
attributes.field_text: あふさかの / ＊関とめらるる / 我なれは / 近江てふらん / かたもしられす / ＊２関ともらるるイ
attributes.field_text_romaji: Ausaka no / seki tomeraruru / ware nareba / afumi (ōmi) chōran / kata mo shirarezu
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Ausaka no / seki tomeraruru / ware nareba / afumi (ōmi) chōran / kata mo shirarezu

attributes.title: 5bfc17e3a7372ae5b2244249
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 又女のつかはしける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 又女のつかはしける
attributes.field_text: ゆきかへり / きてもきかなん / あふさかの / 関にかはれる / 人もありやと
attributes.field_text_romaji: yukikaeri / kite mo kikanan / Ausaka no / seki ni kawareru / hito mo ari ya to
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: yukikaeri / kite mo kikanan / Ausaka no / seki ni kawareru / hito mo ari ya to

attributes.title: 5bfc17e3a7372ae5b224424a
attributes.field_kotobagaki: かへし
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: かへし
attributes.field_text: もる人も / ありとはきけと / あふ坂の / せきもととめぬ / わか涙かな
attributes.field_text_romaji: moru hito mo / ari to wa kikedo / Ausaka no / seki mo todomenu / waga namida kana
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: moru hito mo / ari to wa kikedo / Ausaka no / seki mo todomenu / waga namida kana

attributes.title: 5bfc17e3a7372ae5b224424b
attributes.field_kotobagaki: あふさかの関に庵室をつくりてすみ侍けるに、行かふ人をみて
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: あふさかの関に庵室をつくりてすみ侍けるに、行かふ人をみて
attributes.field_text: 是やこの / ゆくもかへるも / ＊別つつ / しるもしらぬも / あふさかの関 / ＊３別てはイ
attributes.field_text_romaji: kore ya kono / yuku mo kaeru mo / wakaretsutsu / shiru mo shiranu mo / Ausaka no seki
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: kore ya kono / yuku mo kaeru mo / wakaretsutsu / shiru mo shiranu mo / Ausaka no seki
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'Here it is: the gate/ where people coming and going/  must part company,/ where both friends and strangers meet  ̶ / on the slopes of Meeting Hill.', 'source': 'Carter, Steven (1991): p.208'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e3a7372ae5b224424c
attributes.field_kotobagaki: しはすはかりにあつまよりまてきけるおとこの、もとより京にあひしりて侍ける女のもとに、正月ついたちまてをとつれす侍けれは
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: しはすはかりにあつまよりまてきけるおとこの、もとより京にあひしりて侍ける女のもとに、正月ついたちまてをとつれす侍けれは
attributes.field_text: まつ人は / きぬときけとも / あら玉の / としのみこゆる / あふさかのせき
attributes.field_text_romaji: matsu hito wa / kinu to kikedomo / aratama no / toshi nomi koyuru / Ausaka no seki
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: matsu hito wa / kinu to kikedomo / aratama no / toshi nomi koyuru / Ausaka no seki

attributes.title: 5bfc17e3a7372ae5b224424d
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 女につかはしける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 女につかはしける
attributes.field_text: 夜もすから / ＊ぬれてわひつる / から衣 / あふ坂山に / 道まとひして / ＊２ぬれてわひつつイ
attributes.field_text_romaji: yo mo sugara / nurete wabitsuru / karakoromo / Ausaka yama ni / michimadoi shite
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: yo mo sugara / nurete wabitsuru / karakoromo / Ausaka yama ni / michimadoi shite
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'Through the night/ sodden from my travail/  the Chinese robe/   at Osaka Mountain/   I have lost my way.', 'source': 'Kern, J. Christopher'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e3a7372ae5b224424e
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 女のもとにつかはしける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 女のもとにつかはしける
attributes.field_text: なにしおはは / あふさか山の / さねかつら / 人にしられて / くるよしもかな
attributes.field_text_romaji: na ni shi owaba / Ausakayama no / sanekazura / hito ni shirarede / kuru yoshi mogana
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: na ni shi owaba / Ausakayama no / sanekazura / hito ni shirarede / kuru yoshi mogana
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'If true to their name,/ these “secret vines” I send you/ from Meeting Hill/ may wind me a way to you/  unseen by the eyes of men.', 'source': 'Carter, Steven (1991): p.212'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e3a7372ae5b224424f
attributes.field_kotobagaki: ものいひ侍ける女にとしのはてのころほひつかはしける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: ものいひ侍ける女にとしのはてのころほひつかはしける
attributes.field_text: あら玉の / としはけふあす / こえぬへし / あふ坂山を / 我やをくれん
attributes.field_text_romaji: aratama no / toshi wa kyō asu / koenubeshi / Ausaka yama o / ware ya okuren
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: aratama no / toshi wa kyō asu / koenubeshi / Ausaka yama o / ware ya okuren

attributes.title: 5bfc17e3a7372ae5b2244250
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 延喜御時、月次御屏風に
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 延喜御時、月次御屏風に
attributes.field_text: 相坂の / 関のし水に / 影みえて / いまやひくらん / もち月のこま
attributes.field_text_romaji: Ausaka no / seki no shimizu ni / kage miete / ima ya hikuran / mochizuki no koma
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Ausaka no / seki no shimizu ni / kage miete / ima ya hikuran / mochizuki no koma

attributes.title: 5bfc17e3a7372ae5b2244251
attributes.field_kotobagaki: ものへまかりける人のをくり、せき山まてし侍とて
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: ものへまかりける人のをくり、せき山まてし侍とて
attributes.field_text: わかれ行 / けふはまとひぬ / あふ坂は / かへりこん日の / 名にこそ有けれ
attributes.field_text_romaji: wakare yuku / kyō wa madoinu / Ausaka wa / kaerikon hi no / na ni koso arikere
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: wakare yuku / kyō wa madoinu / Ausaka wa / kaerikon hi no / na ni koso arikere

attributes.title: 5bfc17e3a7372ae5b2244252
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 伊勢よりのほり侍けるに、しのひて物いひ侍ける女のあつまへくたりけるか、あふさかにまかりあひて侍けるにつかはしける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 伊勢よりのほり侍けるに、しのひて物いひ侍ける女のあつまへくたりけるか、あふさかにまかりあひて侍けるにつかはしける
attributes.field_text: ゆくすゑの / 命もしらぬ / わかれちは / けふ相坂や / かきりなるらん
attributes.field_text_romaji: yukusue no / inochi mo shiranu / wakareji wa / kyō Ausaka ya / kagiri naruran
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: yukusue no / inochi mo shiranu / wakareji wa / kyō Ausaka ya / kagiri naruran

attributes.title: 5bfc17e3a7372ae5b2244253
attributes.field_text: あふさかを / けさこえくれは / 山人の / ちとせつけとて / きれるつえ也
attributes.field_text_romaji: Ausaka o / kesa koekureba / yamabito no / chitose tsuke tote / kireru tsue nari
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Ausaka o / kesa koekureba / yamabito no / chitose tsuke tote / kireru tsue nari

attributes.title: 5bfc17e3a7372ae5b2244254
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 清慎公五十賀の屏風に
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 清慎公五十賀の屏風に
attributes.field_text: はしり井の / 程をしらはや / 相坂の / 関ひきこゆる / 夕かけのこま
attributes.field_text_romaji: hashirii no / hodo o shirabaya / Ausaka no / seki hikikoyuru / yūkake no koma
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: hashirii no / hodo o shirabaya / Ausaka no / seki hikikoyuru / yūkake no koma

attributes.title: 5bfc17e3a7372ae5b2244255
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 八月こまむかへをよめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 八月こまむかへをよめる
attributes.field_text: あふさかの / ＊関の杉むら / ひくほとは / おふちにみゆる / もち月の駒 / ＊２杉のむら立イ
attributes.field_text_romaji: Ausaka no / seki no sugimura / hikuhodo wa / obuchi ni miyuru / mochizuki no koma
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Ausaka no / seki no sugimura / hikuhodo wa / obuchi ni miyuru / mochizuki no koma

attributes.title: 5bfc17e3a7372ae5b2244256
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 屏風のゑに、こまむかへしたるところをよみ侍りける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 屏風のゑに、こまむかへしたるところをよみ侍りける
attributes.field_text: もち月の / 駒引時は / あふさかの / 木の下やみも / みえすそありける
attributes.field_text_romaji: mochizuki no / koma hiku toki wa / Ausaka no / ko no shitayami mo / miezu zo arikeru
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: mochizuki no / koma hiku toki wa / Ausaka no / ko no shitayami mo / miezu zo arikeru

attributes.title: 5bfc17e3a7372ae5b2244257
attributes.field_kotobagaki: うへのをのことも所の名をさくりて歌たてまつり侍けるに、あふ坂の関のこひをよませたまへる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: うへのをのことも所の名をさくりて歌たてまつり侍けるに、あふ坂の関のこひをよませたまへる
attributes.field_text: あふさかの / 名をもたのまし / 恋すれは / せきのし水に / 袖もぬれけり
attributes.field_text_romaji: Ausaka no / na o mo tanomaji / koi sureba / seki no shimizu ni / sode mo nurekeri
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Ausaka no / na o mo tanomaji / koi sureba / seki no shimizu ni / sode mo nurekeri

attributes.title: 5bfc17e3a7372ae5b2244258
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 思ひけるわらはの三井寺にまかりて、久しうをともし侍らさりけれはよみ侍りける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 思ひけるわらはの三井寺にまかりて、久しうをともし侍らさりけれはよみ侍りける
attributes.field_text: あふ坂の / 関のし水や / にこるらん / 入にし人の / かけもみえぬは

attributes.field_kotobagaki: 石山にたひたひまうて給けるを、はてのたひ関の清水のもとに御車ととめて、このたひはかりやと心ほそく御らんしてよませ給うける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 石山にたひたひまうて給けるを、はてのたひ関の清水のもとに御車ととめて、このたひはかりやと心ほそく御らんしてよませ給うける
attributes.field_text: あまたたひ / 行あふさかの / 関水に / 今は限の / 影そかなしき
attributes.field_text_romaji: amata tabi / yuku Ausaka no / sekimizu ni / ima wa kagiri no / kage zo kanashiki
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: amata tabi / yuku Ausaka no / sekimizu ni / ima wa kagiri no / kage zo kanashiki

attributes.title: 5bfc17e4a7372ae5b2244277
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 和歌所にて、関路鶯といふ事を
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 和歌所にて、関路鶯といふ事を
attributes.field_text: うくひすの / なけともいまた / ふる雪に / ＊杉の葉白き / ＊逢坂の山 / ＊４杉の葉白しイ / ＊５逢坂の関イ
attributes.field_text_romaji: uguisu no / nakedomo imada / furu yuki ni / sugi no ha shiroki / Ausaka no yama
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: uguisu no / nakedomo imada / furu yuki ni / sugi no ha shiroki / Ausaka no yama
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'a mountain thrush calls/ but still the snow flakes fall on/ cryptomeria/ needles \tsilvery white/  mountains of Ōsaka', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.11'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e4a7372ae5b2244278
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 関路花を
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 関路花を
attributes.field_text: あふ坂や/木すゑの花を/吹からに/嵐そかすむ/関のすきむら
attributes.field_text_romaji: Ausaka ya / kozue no hana o / fuku kara ni / arashi zo kasumu / seki no sugimura
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Ausaka ya / kozue no hana o / fuku kara ni / arashi zo kasumu / seki no sugimura
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'at Meeting Hill \twind/ whistles through blossoms on slender/ branches \tas the storm/ grows \tit casts a haze over/ cedar groves at the barrier', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.58'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e4a7372ae5b2244279
attributes.field_kotobagaki: あふ坂の関ちかきわたりにすみ侍けるに、とをき所にまかりける人に餞し侍て
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: あふ坂の関ちかきわたりにすみ侍けるに、とをき所にまかりける人に餞し侍て
attributes.field_text: 相坂の/関に我宿/なかりせは/わかるる人は/たのまさらまし
attributes.field_text_romaji: Ausaka no / seki ni waga yado / nakariseba / wakaruru hito wa / tanomazaramashi
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Ausaka no / seki ni waga yado / nakariseba / wakaruru hito wa / tanomazaramashi
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'were my home not near/ the Ōsaka barrier/ gate \tMeeting Hill \tthen/ I’d not hope to meet again/ one who must now depart', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.356'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e4a7372ae5b224427a
attributes.field_kotobagaki: つれなく侍ける女に、しはすのつこもりにつかはしける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: つれなく侍ける女に、しはすのつこもりにつかはしける
attributes.field_text: あら玉の/年にまかせて/見るよりは/我こそこえめ/あふ坂の関
attributes.field_text_romaji: aratama no / toshi ni makasete / miru yori wa / ware koso koeme / Ausaka no seki
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: aratama no / toshi ni makasete / miru yori wa / ware koso koeme / Ausaka no seki
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'rather than give up/ and wait for the approaching/  fresh year to bring you/  to me \tI will myself cross/ the Meeting Hill barrier', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.412'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e4a7372ae5b224427b
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: けさよりは/いとと思ひを/たきまして/なけきこりつむ/相坂の山
attributes.field_text_romaji: kesa yori wa / itodo omoi o / takimashite / nageki koritsumu / Ausaka no yama
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: kesa yori wa / itodo omoi o / takimashite / nageki koritsumu / Ausaka no yama
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'from this morning on/ I’ll kindle the fires of love/ ever more \tfelling/ and stacking logs of heartache/ on the slopes of Meeting Hill', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.480'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e4a7372ae5b224427c
attributes.field_kotobagaki: よしの河のほとりに、やまふきのさけりけるをよめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: よしの河のほとりに、やまふきのさけりけるをよめる
attributes.field_text: よしの川 / 岸の山吹 / ふく風に / そこのかけさへ / うつろひにけり
attributes.field_text_romaji: Yoshinogawa / kishi no yamabuki / fuku kaze ni / soko no kage sae / utsuroinikeri
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Yoshinogawa / kishi no yamabuki / fuku kaze ni / soko no kage sae / utsuroinikeri
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'the blowing winds which/ toss the mountain roses to/ the banks of River/ Yoshino \thave scattered their/ bright reflection in the depths', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.83'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e4a7372ae5b224427d
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: よしの川 / いはなみたかく / 行水の / はやくそ人を / 思ひそめてし
attributes.field_text_romaji: Yoshinogawa / iwanami takaku / yuku mizu no / hayaku zo hito o / omoisometeshi
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Yoshinogawa / iwanami takaku / yuku mizu no / hayaku zo hito o / omoisometeshi
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'so suddenly was/ my heart dyed with passion for/ you \tit leapt high as/ the waves in the waters of/ the swift Yoshino River', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.183-184'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e4a7372ae5b224427e
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 吉野川 / いはきりとをし / 行水の / 音にはたてし / 恋はしぬとも
attributes.field_text_romaji: Yoshinogawa / iwakiri tōshi / yuku mizu no / oto ni wa tateji / koi wa shinu tomo
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Yoshinogawa / iwakiri tōshi / yuku mizu no / oto ni wa tateji / koi wa shinu tomo
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'the gurgling waters/ of the Yoshino River/ cut deep through the rocks  ̶  /in silence I will love you/ although I may die yearning', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.190'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e4a7372ae5b224427f
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 芳野河 / 水の心は / はやくとも / たきの音には / たてしとそ思
attributes.field_text_romaji: Yoshinogawa / mizu no kokoro wa / hayaku tomo / taki no oto ni wa / tateji to zo omou
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Yoshinogawa / mizu no kokoro wa / hayaku tomo / taki no oto ni wa / tateji to zo omou
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'Yoshino River/ the heart of the waters flows/ swiftly \tbut I will/ never let rumors rise \tloud/ as the sound of the rapids', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.236'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e4a7372ae5b2244280
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 逢事は / 玉のをはかり / 名のたつは / 吉野の川の / たきつせのこと
attributes.field_text_romaji: au koto wa / tama no o bakari / na no tatsu wa / Yoshino no kawa no / tagitsu se no goto
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: au koto wa / tama no o bakari / na no tatsu wa / Yoshino no kawa no / tagitsu se no goto
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'our meeting was as/ short as the thread between the/  gems of a necklace/ but the gossip will swell like/ the Yoshino River waves', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.242'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e4a7372ae5b2244281
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: みよしのの / おほかは野への / 藤なみの / なみに思はは / わかこひめやは
attributes.field_text_romaji: Miyoshino no / ōkawa nobe no / fujinami no / nami ni omowaba / waga koime ya wa
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Miyoshino no / ōkawa nobe no / fujinami no / nami ni omowaba / waga koime ya wa
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'like the waving sprays/ of wisteria boughs near/ the swift river at/ fair Yoshino \tmy love flows/ to you in no common way', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.250'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e5a7372ae5b2244282
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: よしのかは / よしや人こそ / つらからめ / はやくいひてし / ことは忘れし
attributes.field_text_romaji: Yoshinogawa / yoshi ya hito koso / tsurakarame / hayaku iite shi / koto wa wasureji
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Yoshinogawa / yoshi ya hito koso / tsurakarame / hayaku iite shi / koto wa wasureji
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'although you’ve become/ cold as the waters of the/  Yoshino River/ I shall never forget the/ pledge I made when first we met', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.277'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e5a7372ae5b2244283
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: なかれては / 妹背の山の / なかにおつる / よしのの川の / よしや世中
attributes.field_text_romaji: nagarete wa / Imose no yama no / naka ni otsuru / Yoshino no kawa no / yoshi ya yo no naka
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: nagarete wa / Imose no yama no / naka ni otsuru / Yoshino no kawa no / yoshi ya yo no naka
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'like the Yoshino/ River cascading between/ Husband and Wife peaks/ obstacles forever part/ lovers in this world of ours', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.286'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e5a7372ae5b2244284
attributes.field_text: よしのかはをひきて世中をうらみきつるに今は
attributes.field_text_romaji: Yoshinogawa o hikite yonaka o uramikitsuru ni ima wa
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Yoshinogawa o hikite yonaka o uramikitsuru ni ima wa
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': '[…] alluding to the Yoshino River, he complained of the ways of the world of love; […]', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.41'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e5a7372ae5b2244285
attributes.field_kotobagaki: やまとのくににまかれりける時に、ゆきのふりけるをみてよめる
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: やまとのくににまかれりける時に、ゆきのふりけるをみてよめる
attributes.field_text: 朝ほらけ / 有明の月と / 見るまてに / 吉野の里に / ふれる白雪
attributes.field_text_romaji: asaborake / ariake no tsuki to / miru made ni / Yoshino no sato ni / fureru shirayuki
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: asaborake / ariake no tsuki to / miru made ni / Yoshino no sato ni / fureru shirayuki
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'in the first light of/ dawn it seems a reflection/ of the moon lingering/ above \twhite snow has fallen/ here in Yoshino Village', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.142'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e5a7372ae5b2244286
attributes.field_kotobagaki: をかたまの木
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: をかたまの木
attributes.field_text: みよしのの / 吉野の滝に / うかひいつる / あはをかたまの / きゆとみつらん
attributes.field_text_romaji: Miyoshino no / Yoshino no taki ni / ukabi izuru / awa o ka tama no / kiyu to mitsuran
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Miyoshino no / Yoshino no taki ni / ukabi izuru / awa o ka tama no / kiyu to mitsuran
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'these bubbles of pearl/ foaming on the rapids of/ lovely Yoshino  ̶  / did men of old too \tsee these/ as fragile gems \there and gone', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.172'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e5a7372ae5b2244287
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 春霞 / たてるやいつこ / みよしのの / 吉野の山に / 雪はふりつつ
attributes.field_text_romaji: harugasumi / tateru ya izuko / Miyoshino no / Yoshino no yama ni / yuki wa furitsutsu
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: harugasumi / tateru ya izuko / Miyoshino no / Yoshino no yama ni / yuki wa furitsutsu
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'where is it that the/ warm mists of spring are rising  ̶  / here on the slopes/  of lovely Mount Yoshino/ the snows continue to fall', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.50'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e5a7372ae5b2244288
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 寛平御時きさいの宮の歌合のうた
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 寛平御時きさいの宮の歌合のうた
attributes.field_text: みよしのの / 山へにさける / 桜花 / 雪かとのみそ / あやまたれける
attributes.field_text_romaji: Miyoshino no / yamabe ni sakeru / sakurabana / yuki ka to nomi zo / ayamatarekeru
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Miyoshino no / yamabe ni sakeru / sakurabana / yuki ka to nomi zo / ayamatarekeru
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'far in the distance/ on lovely Mount Yoshino/ cherry blossoms must/ have opened \tfor as I gazed/ I thought I saw snowdrifts there', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.66'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e5a7372ae5b2244289
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 夕されは / 衣手さむし / みよしのの / 吉のの山に / み雪ふるらし
attributes.field_text_romaji: yū sareba / koromode samushi / Miyoshino no / Yoshino no yama ni / miyuki furu rashi
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: yū sareba / koromode samushi / Miyoshino no / Yoshino no yama ni / miyuki furu rashi
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'as evening deepens/ the sleeves of my robe grow cold  ̶   / in fair Yoshino/ on lovely Mount Yoshino/ soft white snow must be falling', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.138'}]

attributes.title: 5bfc17e5a7372ae5b224428a
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 題知らず
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 題知らず
attributes.field_text: 古郷は / 吉のの山し / ちかけれは / ひとひもみ雪 / ふらぬ日はなし
attributes.field_text_romaji: furusato wa / Yoshino no yama shi / chikakereba / hitohi mo miyuki / furanu hi wa nashi
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: furusato wa / Yoshino no yama shi / chikakereba / hitohi mo miyuki / furanu hi wa nashi
